article.title: Malaysia’s AI agent-powered messaging app Respond.io raises $62.5M, eyes acquisitions
article.description: Respond.io, one of Malaysia startups to watch, uses AI agents to handle high volumes of customer inquiries and charges per convo, not per seat.
article.author: Kate Park

instagram_caption:
Bakit ka pa magbabayad para sa upuan kung pwede namang per usapan na lang ang singilan? Malaysia's Respond.io just secured $62.5M para palakihin pa ang kanilang AI-agent messaging platform.

Alamin kung paano binabago ng AI agents ang customer support pricing model at kung bakit patungo na tayo sa pay-per-conversation era.

Ano sa tingin mo, mas makakatipid ba ang mga local startups sa ganitong pricing model?

#VibeCodersPH #RespondIO #AIAgents #SaaS #TechNewsPH #StartupLife

Source: https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/15/malaysias-respond-io-raises-62-5m-eyes-acquisitions-in-north-america-and-europe/

slides.headline: Respond.io raises 62.5 million Series B
slides.body: Malaysian customer conversation platform Respond.io secures new funding to scale its AI agent-powered messaging software and pursue strategic acquisitions globally.

slides.headline: Annual recurring revenue hits 35 million
slides.body: The startup reports rapid financial growth, reaching $35 million in ARR with a 169% year-over-year growth rate and a 30% profit margin.

slides.headline: Platform processes 2 billion quarterly messages
slides.body: High-volume customer interactions across WhatsApp, Instagram, and TikTok fuel the platform, processing billions of messages to automate lead qualification and sales.
slides.why: quantified message volume and adoption scale

slides.headline: Pricing model charges per conversation
slides.body: Unlike traditional SaaS platforms charging per seat, Respond.io bills by conversation volume, ensuring revenue remains stable even as AI agents replace human agents.
slides.why: strategic pricing model details for AI agent adoption

slides.headline: Data flywheel powers better AI agents
slides.body: Processing massive message volumes creates a continuous feedback loop, training superior AI models that attract more enterprise customers and generate more data.
slides.why: technical strategy and data moat details
